# LuckyStock AI

LuckyStock AI provides Korean stock analysis support pages and structured summaries for search and assistant retrieval.

## Site
- https://luckystock.pages.dev/
- https://luckystock.pages.dev/about
- https://luckystock.pages.dev/privacy
- https://luckystock.pages.dev/contact

## Content
- Korean stock ticker analysis summaries
- ranking/signal/theme dashboards
- risk and outlook fields per ticker

## Policy
- Informational use only
- Not financial advice
